column4: The section starts from the human body made in a fitting form; this verse recalls its creation from a lowly fluid, giving the formed body an explicit, humble beginning.
The section’s root note says a body needs support to remain upright; this next verse places the human fluid in a firm lodging, a specific image of bodily support.
The section describes a body given its proper form; this next verse says the fluid remains in that lodging for a known term, completing the gestation sequence begun in 77:20–21.
The section’s image of proportioned bodily form meets this next verse’s language of measuring or decreeing the creation, which concludes the sequence of 77:20–22.
The section contrasts the lowered human with the faithful exception; this verse says the one who purifies himself succeeds, giving a specific positive path alongside the low outcome.
The section’s exception is for those who believe and do good; this next verse specifies remembering the Lord and praying as acts of the successful person in 87:14.
The section connects the body with earth as its resting ground; this verse calls the earth a bed, a specific image of the surface that supports life.
The section’s dictionary form قِوَام names what keeps a thing standing; this next verse calls mountains pegs, an explicit support image continuing the earth-as-bed scene in 78:6.
The section says support is what keeps a thing upright; this verse says God set firm mountains in the earth lest it shake with people, a concrete stabilizing role.
The section’s support image is made concrete here: God placed firm mountains in the earth so it would not shake with people, alongside rivers and paths.
The section centers on the human’s fitted form; this verse explicitly compares the difficulty of creating people with creating the heaven, before describing the heaven’s raised structure.
The section describes a body standing in its best proportion; this next verse says the heaven was raised and proportioned, continuing the creation comparison in 79:27.
The section’s body is lowered to an earthly ground; this verse says the earth was spread out, an explicit counterpart to that ground.
The section names a support that keeps a body standing; this verse says God firmly set the mountains, a specific instance of stabilizing support in the earth scene.
